title: An element attribute map lookup can return null

ground_truth.statement: An element attribute map lookup can return null. After a null guard its DOMAttr value is a string, including an empty string for an explicitly empty attribute.

notes: Clean-room semantic contract derived from the catalog lead, not a copy of its test harness. Runtime controls distinguish successful values from rejected or absent alternatives. This is a behavior comparison, not a recommendation that every precision limitation is product policy. Pinned-tool observations retained without widening expectations: psalm: MixedReturnStatement@7, PossiblyNullReference@5, UndefinedPropertyFetch@7; mago: possible-method-access-on-null@5. Runtime controls pass. These are measured precision or contract-interpretation disagreements, not assertions that the tool should adopt every tested policy.
